description: Tap the map to toggle the search bar; automatically hide after 10 seconds

patches.name: Waze Minimize Search Bar
patches.description: Tap the map to hide or reveal the search bar; hide it after 10 seconds of inactivity.

release_notes:
Restores the original search-bar height. Tap the map to hide the sheet completely; tap again to show it. The sheet is set to hide after 10 seconds without touch interaction.

Tested by compiling and applying the bundle to Waze Mod 5.24.5.0. Device behavior has not yet been verified; please test tapping, dragging, typing, and the timer.
repoDescription: Morphe patch to minimize the Waze Mod search bar
